summary: Pipamazine was removed from the United States market starting in 1969 due to liver damage [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated high risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M]. In addition, similar drugs have faced severe warnings or market removals for issues including mental health harm, heart damage, infections, blood vessel harm, stomach and gut problems, and nerve damage [3][4][5].
